title: Yellowed British Minced Beef Gratin
description: A fresh and indulgent British dish featuring minced beef, steamed to perfection and served in a raclette grill, this Yellowed British Minced Beef Gratin is a low-carb friendly delight. It is a pillowy and flavorful meal that is sure to satisfy.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, combine the minced beef, chopped onion, sliced mushrooms, melted butter, grated cheese, double cream, dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Mix all the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a raclette grill dish.
Steam the mixture in the raclette grill for 10 minutes.
After steaming, grill the top of the mixture for 2 minutes to give it a yellowed crust.
Remove the dish from the grill and let it rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the Yellowed British Minced Beef Gratin hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Use a spoon to portion out individual servings.
